newsitem.title: GERMANY: Poland, Russia jewellery markets seen expanding.
newsitem.headline: Poland, Russia jewellery markets seen expanding.

text.p: Russia and Poland offer Western jewellery companies new export potential, a news release from the organisers of an east German trade fair said.
The annual Midora jewellery trade fair in Leipzig, which ran from August 31 to September 2, attracted 6,000 visitors, including traders from Poland, Russia and the Czech Republic.

The organisers said research presented at a seminar during the fair put annual spending on gold and silver jewellery in Russia at $650 million and noted that the total was growing after a slump in the early 1990s.
In addition, Russian consumers spent an estimated five billion dollars a year on jewellery during trips abroad.
In Poland, half of the products on offer in jewellery stores were imports, mostly from Italy, the statement said.
